headline: How much tile do you need?
sub: Length x width for each area, then extra for cuts. Every tile page has a calculator.
caption:
How much tile do you need?
Measure the length and width of each floor or wall in metres and multiply them. Add the areas together. Then allow about 10% extra for cuts and breakages.
Or use the tile calculator on any tile page and it does the sum for you.
https://excellenttilingservices.com/collections/tiles
